author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! Following up to a video yesterday I want to dive a bit more into the legal mechanism used to subpoena Discord for valuable private information on thousands of users... over leaked videos of a game. This needs to be fought back by Discord and Microsoft. Why? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: Discord Has To Fight Back Against Rockstar Games...
